title: Source Index
description: Stage 1 output. Everything the uploaded documents contain, addressable by anchor: text chunks, tables, extracted images, and the topic list the deck must cover. Every source citation anywhere downstream resolves to an anchor in this file, which is what makes a claim in the deck checkable against the spec.

doc_id.description: Short stable handle used in anchors, e.g. 'FSD'

images_extracted.description: False for kinds this pipeline reads text-only (pdf, txt, md). Stage 5 uses it so a document whose images were never looked for is not reported as having none.

chunks.description: Heading-anchored units of text. A chunk is the smallest thing a slide can cite.

anchor.description: Stable citation, '<doc_id>#<clause-or-slug>' with an optional '@p<n>'. This is the string that appears in a plan block's sources array.

heading_path.description: Ancestor headings, outermost first — the chunk's position in the document.

clause.description: Numbered clause if the heading carried one, e.g. '4.2.1'

ordinal.description: Document order. Drives which screenshot belongs to which step.

page.description: Page estimate; null when the format has no pages

tables.description: Tables appearing inside this chunk, kept as rows. Flattening a field-rules table to prose loses the mandatory/optional column, which is exactly the content training must get right.

assets.description: Images extracted from the documents, written to the run's assets/ directory as original bytes.

path.description: Path on disk, relative to the run workspace

asset_kind.description: Classified on ingest by cheap heuristics, corrected by the model at Stage 3. Only screenshot/diagram/chart are candidates for placement and subject to the Stage 5 triage check, so a repeated header logo cannot end up on a slide or be reported as a dropped screenshot.

caption.description: Figure caption, when the document carried one

anchor.description: The chunk anchor this image sat under

sha256.description: De-duplicates the logo that repeats in every page header

occurrences.description: How many times these exact bytes appear across the documents

sheet_ref.description: Sheet and cell anchor, for xlsx sources

topics.description: Candidate teachable topics, one per in-scope heading. These are to this pipeline what requirement IDs are to the proposal generator: Stage 2 maps them to modules and Stage 5 checks none went missing without a reason.

word_count.description: How much the document dwells on it — Stage 2 sizes modules by this, never by invented emphasis

in_scope.description: Set false for document furniture — revision history, sign-off tables, distribution lists. Out-of-scope topics are exempt from the coverage check.

scope_note.description: Required when in_scope is false — why this is not teachable content

warnings.description: Non-fatal ingest problems, surfaced rather than swallowed.
